verified: Actual request immutable audit snapshot, exact receipt and cancellation/TOCTOU recheck immediately before downstream stream
Full approved system/developer/user content mapped to exact official serialized wire with strict route/tools/field controls
wx script-attempt marker and generation counter consumed before first await/transport
Read-only existing account record; no API key/login/refresh/credential write
Sticky cleanup failure rejects unsafe disposal; prior completed return stays committed
Fixed public material and isolated Knot store; no apply/HTTP or running Desktop deployment

limitations: Preflight is not actual Run completion or product acceptance

Knot persistence lacks fsync/power-loss proof; no production recovery guarantee
